name: API Mock
author: duncanireri
description: Local mock server for APIs and webhooks, in WireMock's stub format. Point it at a JSON file, pick a port, run it from the bar.

barWidget.description: Start and stop a local mock server, pick its mappings file and port, and watch the requests it serves.

schema.label: Mappings file or folder
schema.description: A WireMock-style JSON file, or a folder of *.json files. ~ is expanded.

schema.label: Bind address
schema.description: 127.0.0.1 keeps the mock private to this machine; 0.0.0.0 exposes it on the network.

schema.label: Start the server when the shell starts
